entities.label: entity_name

entities.sql:
WITH ep AS (
  SELECT from_bank AS b, from_account AS a, event_date AS d FROM {silver_aml.transfer}
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_bank, to_account, event_date FROM {silver_aml.transfer}),
seen AS (SELECT b, a, min(d) AS first_seen FROM ep GROUP BY b, a),
k AS (SELECT bank_id AS b, account_number AS a FROM {silver_aml.account}
      UNION SELECT b, a FROM seen)
SELECT k.b AS bank_id, k.a AS account_number, s.first_seen
FROM k LEFT JOIN seen s ON s.b = k.b AND s.a = k.a
WHERE k.b IS NOT NULL AND k.a IS NOT NULL
entities.label: concat('TK AML ', bank_id, '-', account_number)

FROM {silver_aml.laundering_attempt} la

edges.sql:
SELECT from_bank, from_account, to_bank, to_account,
       min(event_date) AS first_date, max(event_date) AS last_date, count(*) AS n_txn
FROM {silver_aml.transfer}
WHERE NOT coalesce(is_self_transfer, false)
  AND from_bank IS NOT NULL AND from_account IS NOT NULL AND to_bank IS NOT NULL AND to_account IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY from_bank, from_account, to_bank, to_account

SELECT attempt_id, b, a, min(event_date) AS first_date FROM (
  SELECT la.attempt_id, la.from_bank AS b, la.from_account AS a, t.event_date
  FROM {silver_aml.laundering_attempt} la LEFT JOIN {silver_aml.transfer} t ON t.txn_id = la.txn_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT la.attempt_id, la.to_bank, la.to_account, t.event_date
  FROM {silver_aml.laundering_attempt} la LEFT JOIN {silver_aml.transfer} t ON t.txn_id = la.txn_id) x
WHERE b IS NOT NULL AND a IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY attempt_id, b, a

SELECT attempt_id, max(typology) AS typology FROM {silver_aml.laundering_attempt}
WHERE typology IS NOT NULL GROUP BY attempt_id
edges.expect_rows: SELECT count(DISTINCT attempt_id) FROM {silver_aml.laundering_attempt} WHERE typology IS NOT NULL

FROM (
  SELECT client_id, report_month,
         stack(4, 1, target_1, 2, target_2, 3, target_3, 4, target_4) AS (k, flag)

) t
WHERE flag
GROUP BY client_id, k
